proof_body:
by
  intro Ω _ P _ X c h
  refine ⟨h.integrable, ?_⟩
  have h0 : (0 : ℝ) ∈ interior (ProbabilityTheory.integrableExpSet X P) := by
    rw [h.integrableExpSet_eq_univ]; simp
  have hd : HasDerivAt (ProbabilityTheory.mgf X P) (∫ ω, X ω ∂P) 0 := by
    have := ProbabilityTheory.hasDerivAt_mgf h0
    simpa using this
  have hg : HasDerivAt (fun t : ℝ => Real.exp ((c : ℝ) * t ^ 2 / 2)) 0 0 := by
    have h1 : HasDerivAt (fun t : ℝ => (c : ℝ) * t ^ 2 / 2) 0 0 := by
      have := ((hasDerivAt_id (0 : ℝ)).pow 2).const_mul (c : ℝ) |>.div_const 2
      simpa using this
    simpa using h1.exp
  have hmax : IsLocalMax (fun t => ProbabilityTheory.mgf X P t - Real.exp ((c : ℝ) * t ^ 2 / 2)) 0 := by
    refine Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun t => ?_
    simp only [ProbabilityTheory.mgf_zero]
    have := h.mgf_le t
    simp
    linarith
  have := hmax.hasDerivAt_eq_zero (hd.sub hg)
  linarith
target_source: ∀ (Ω : Type*) [MeasurableSpace Ω] (P : MeasureTheory.Measure Ω) [MeasureTheory.IsProbabilityMeasure P] (X : Ω → ℝ) (c : NNReal), ProbabilityTheory.HasSubgaussianMGF X c P → MeasureTheory.Integrable X P ∧ ∫ ω, X ω ∂P = 0
